top_signals.title: Bitcoin production slips again in July for CleanSpark, BitFuFu and Canaan
top_signals.summary: CleanSpark is up 6.4% year to date, while BitFuFu and Canaan have fallen more than 50% and 70%, respectively.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Hedge Fund Tax Break Grips Hong Kong as Banks Fear Exodus
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s move to cut taxes for hedge funds has set off a frenzied wave of maneuvering across the city’s financial sector, with investment banks fearing an exodus of prop traders and one fund even considering rebranding a receptionist as an investor relations official to make the most of the potential windfall.
